assumptions.obligation: The APB Requester is reset together with the bridge. While i_rst_n_core is low, i_apb_psel and i_apb_penable are 0.
A Setup phase (PSEL=1, PENABLE=0) is followed in the next cycle by an Access phase (PSEL=1, PENABLE=1). The Access phase holds PSEL and PENABLE high until o_apb_pready is 1.

PENABLE is high only in an Access phase that follows a Setup phase or continues an Access phase that is not complete. After PREADY the next cycle is idle or a new Setup phase (back-to-back with PSEL held high is allowed), and it is never a direct Access phase.
i_apb_paddr, i_apb_pwrite, i_apb_pwdata and i_apb_pstrb stay unchanged from the Setup phase until PREADY.

TL-UL D-channel handshake (REF-005 protocol checked at the ports). When d_valid=1 is not accepted (o_tlul_d_ready=0), the device keeps d_valid high and every D-channel payload field stable in the next cycle.
